charts.question: Which online policies capture later identity reverts?
charts.supported_finding: The two hindsight references see future scores or realized labels and are not deployable.
charts.interpretation_boundary: An identity revert indicates that previously observed page content returned within seven days. It is a behavioral proxy. The replay assumes no effect of the simulated review on subsequent edits.
